# Deniz Karakoyun — The Deniz Tree

> Personal portfolio of Deniz Karakoyun, a Computer Engineering student at Middle East Technical University (METU, Ankara, Türkiye), class of 2027. Focus: operating systems, low-level systems programming, embedded software, C/C++. Co-founder and developer of two shipped products (Guild, Phera Labs). The site is an interactive "tree" — the same content is also available as plain text on the page (section id "cv-text") and as JSON-LD.

## Who

- Computer Engineering student at METU, CGPA 3.62 / 4.00, expected graduation 2027. Ranked 799th out of ~3,000,000 in Türkiye's national university exam (YKS, 2021).
- Aiming at OS, embedded, robotics or infrastructure work — C, C++, Linux, ROS 2.

## Experience

- KUARTIS — Software Engineering Intern (2026, completed, Ankara): completed StateDecider, a C++17 / ROS 2 lifecycle-management system developed with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD). Monitor observes node states; Enforcer reconciles them with mission targets through asynchronous transitions and bounded queues. ROS-independent domain/application logic, automated tests and a browser demo connected to real ROS 2 nodes. Source code exists and is kept private for confidentiality; public draw.io architecture diagrams: https://github.com/karakoyundenizz/StateDecider. Also worked on GNSS signal-health monitoring on NVIDIA Jetson with test-first fixes.
- ASELSAN — Candidate Engineer (Feb – Jul 2026): multithreaded C++ data pipelines processing millions of data points for system evaluation.
- ROMER (METU Robotics & AI Center) — Undergraduate Researcher (Jan – Jul 2026): CNN / ResNet models for honey-bee orientation detection.
- BİTES — Software Engineering Intern (Aug – Sep 2025): C# / WPF desktop app features, xUnit tests.
- ASELSAN — Intern (Jul – Aug 2025): C++ unit tests (GoogleTest) for embedded systems; Python GUI test automation.
- EXA4MIND (EU Horizon project) — Data Mining Intern (Aug – Sep 2024): streaming pipelines with Kafka, Flink, ZeroMQ; ZeroMQ vs Kafka benchmark.

## Products (shipped)

- Guild — student community app for Turkey (iOS, Android, web); co-founder and sole developer; live at nine universities; reached 200+ users (as of August 2026; may have changed). https://getguild.app
- Phera Labs — art-tech platform for student digital art; co-founder and developer; 360° gallery, commerce; featured 25 artists (as of August 2026; may have changed). https://pheralabs.com

## Selected projects (systems)

- Concurrent data pipeline orchestrator in C (fork/exec, IPC over Unix domain sockets).
- Crossroad: a pthreads monitor for a multi-lane intersection — per-car condition variables, per-lane min-heaps keyed by arrival time, priority-aware hand-over. Collision-free, deadlock-free, starvation-free; 100/100.
- mergeext2fs: a three-way merge of ext2 disk images done with raw block I/O — manual inode and block allocation, indirect block chains, directory-entry splicing, superblock and group-descriptor backups; 100/100.
- Networking (CENG435): OMNeT++ / INET throughput, saturation and delay simulations; Wireshark forensics reconstructing a break-in from a plaintext HTTP capture; six IPv4 addressing and routing labs.
- Y86-64 pipelined processor: added instructions, resolved hazards in HCL; optimized a bilateral filter from 1442 to 688 cycles/element (2.1×).
- Bomb & Attack Labs: x86-64 reverse engineering with GDB; code-injection and ROP exploits in a sandboxed lab.
- PIC18 embedded systems: Flappy Bird on an LED matrix with interrupts; timer-free round-robin scheduler; EUSART driver for a three-port EV charging cabinet.
- Flight Finder (C++, multigraph + Dijkstra), AI Model Hub database (SQL schema design), KSO marine-biodiversity platform architecture (74-page SAD + 68-page SRS).
